scenes.line1: How do you test secure APIs?
scenes.say: APIs need security. But how do you test authentication flows without breaking your automation?

scenes.label: Tokens
scenes.sub: APIs use OAuth2 tokens or API keys for authentication.
scenes.say: Most APIs rely on tokens or keys to authenticate requests. You’ll see OAuth2 and API keys everywhere.
To test authentication, first get a token, then renew it if needed, and finally send it in your request headers.
Automate token retrieval in your test setup. Never hardcode credentials—let your tests log in and grab the token each time.

scenes.question: Should you hardcode tokens in tests?
scenes.right: No, automate token retrieval to keep tests secure and maintainable.
scenes.say: Interviewers will ask if you hardcode tokens. Automate token retrieval instead—it's safer and keeps your tests reliable.
